findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "geo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: draft_llms_txt · Private data: check_ai_readiness, get_geo_offer · Public sink: draft_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: draft_llms_txt · Private data: check_ai_readiness, get_geo_offer · Public sink: draft_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
